## Body

2026-11-08 12:35: pm-001's receiver lease lapsed. pij-rs --json list still showed native_extension_delivery True, but pij-rs --json state <seat> had native_receiver_reason = native-extension-unavailable, and sends to the seat and its role were refused or parked. The flag means the seat delivers natively; the reason field says whether the receiver is live now (None = ok). An idle seat with a dead receiver can't be reached by pij, so it needs a typed prompt to run extensions_reload (or /restart). The PA may not type into panes, so report it to the prime with the pane id. Sweep: loop pij-rs --json state over the fleet and print native_receiver_reason.
